# store-query-service

> CQRS read-model — Motor + aiohttp consumers project events into MongoDB + Elasticsearch.

## Docs

- [Overview](wiki/overview.md): Event consumers, trigger-then-fetch composition, indexes, search endpoint, tests.

- Consumers: `services/store-query-service/src/infrastructure/consumers/`

- Search: `services/store-query-service/src/application/search.py`
- Tests: `services/store-query-service/tests/`
